The *Ekapattadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha Ap 504) is a canonical Pali verse narrative preserved in the *Therāpadāna* section of the Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. The poem forms part of the biographical and karmic literature recounting the past-life meritorious actions and spiritual attainments of senior Buddhist monks (*theras*) [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral lists five translations of the text across five languages, without recording a specific English rendering for its title [SuttaCentral].
